threshold.name: Bone Threshold
threshold.desc: The door north is locked. A bone key lies in a bowl of teeth.

nave.name: The Nave
nave.desc: Pews of femurs face an empty altar. A door stands to the east.

scriptorium.name: Scriptorium
scriptorium.desc: Ash and unwritten books. A sealed stair climbs north.

reliquary.name: Reliquary
reliquary.desc: A steel sword and a red vial rest on a cloth of gold thread.

cell.name: Saint's Cell
cell.desc: The cell is circular. The saint in it is not at prayer.

bone_gate.desc: The gate is locked with a clasp shaped like a jaw.
bone_gate.success_msg: The jaw clasp opens. The gate swings in.
bone_gate.fail_msg: Nothing you hold fits the jaw.

ash_riddle.desc: Words burned into the lintel: 'I eat and I am fed, yet I die when I drink. What am I?'
ash_riddle.success_msg: The ash flares. The stair north is clear.
ash_riddle.hint: One word. Water is the end of it.
